case.title: Bundle the fastener kit with one distributor
case.briefing: You negotiate for Hollerau Pumpenwerke with Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH. Bundle the fastener kit with one distributor. Need: 30000 kits a year. Category goal: routine: fewer suppliers and less process cost. Score: the lowest total cost C as defined in the rules, valued with this case's rates (need lead time 5 days). Fallback if you walk away: today's terms continue unchanged. Must-haves: none. Prepare from the data package.

messages.from_name: Inside Sales, Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH
messages.subject: Quote from Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH: Bundle the fastener kit with one distributor
messages.body:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We are delighted to submit our offer for your consideration. We can offer you a price of €5.74 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, and a contract term of 12 months.

As a valued partner, we always strive to support your operations with our extensive inventory and reliable delivery service. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

We look forward to continuing our successful business relationship and standing by as your trusted partner for all your supply needs.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Stadler
Inside Sales, Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH: Bundle the fastener kit with one distributor
messages.body:
Dear Mr. Stadler,

Your offer speaks of reliable delivery and a lasting relationship, and that is exactly what we want to build on: with Option A we bring you a binding volume for your plant, business on top of what you supply us today, over a long contract term.

Option A is the package we can approve. It gives your plant steady, planned load, and the claims below show why the price in it is where it should be.

On the cost side:
Our forecast for Hex bolt ISO 4017 M12x40 8.8, zinc rises 6.0% (fc:360010@2026-09).

On our price history with you:
Our orders of Hex bolt ISO 4017 M12x40 8.8, zinc with you were placed at EUR 12.46 per 100 units on 2024-09-30 (po:4500011486-10), EUR 12.46 per 100 units on 2025-05-26 (po:4500012506-10), EUR 12.46 per 100 units on 2026-01-26 (po:4500013479-10) and EUR 12.46 per 100 units on 2026-09-30 (po:4500014475-10): the price has been unchanged.

Our orders of Hex nut ISO 4032 M12 8, zinc with you were placed at EUR 4.91 per 100 units on 2024-09-30 (po:4500011486-20), EUR 4.91 per 100 units on 2025-06-02 (po:4500012538-10), EUR 4.91 per 100 units on 2026-01-30 (po:4500013504-10) and EUR 4.91 per 100 units on 2026-09-28 (po:4500014466-10): the price has been unchanged.

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 5.20; payment 90 days net; contract term 36 months.
Option B: unit price EUR 5.15; payment 45 days net; contract term 36 months.
Option C: unit price EUR 5.17; payment 60 days net; contract term 36 months.
Binding volume in every option: 30,000 units a year over 36 months.

If you confirm Option A as it stands, we can confirm the order straight away.

Please take Option A to the person who decides on prices and contracts at your company, so that we can reach a clear answer without delay. It is a fair solution for both family companies.

What would you need from us to confirm Option A?

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

messages.from_name: Inside Sales, Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH
messages.subject: Re: Quote from Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH: Bundle the fastener kit with one distributor
messages.body:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We received a lot of material; we looked at what bears on this part. We checked the price history data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. While we have reviewed your historical price data, current conditions require a sustainable baseline for this new bundle. Our price follows our main cost drivers: PPI-C2594, LCI-C.

We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We welcome the commitment to a 36-month contract and the binding volume, which allows us to adjust our offer. A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price. Which volume can you commit to?

Our Angebot provides a price of €5.60 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 36 months. Building on your Option B, we can offer a price of €5.58 per unit, Zahlungsziel 45 days net, a contract term of 36 months. 

Our general terms and conditions apply; the quote lists our standard terms. This offer is valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Stadler
Inside Sales, Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH: Bundle the fastener kit with one distributor
messages.body:
Dear Mr. Stadler,

You asked which volume we can commit to, and the options below answer it: a binding volume for your plant in every option, business on top of what you supply us today, over a long contract term.

Option A is the package we can approve. It gives your plant steady, planned load for the whole term, and with a binding volume you no longer need to price in the uncertainty of changing call-offs.

On your cost drivers, here is what our own orders with you show:
Our orders of Washer ISO 7089 M12, zinc with you were placed at EUR 12.78 per 1,000 units on 2024-10-10 (po:4500011536-10), EUR 12.78 per 1,000 units on 2025-06-11 (po:4500012581-10), EUR 12.78 per 1,000 units on 2026-01-29 (po:4500013501-10) and EUR 12.78 per 1,000 units on 2026-09-28 (po:4500014466-20): the price has been unchanged.

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 5.47; payment 45 days net; contract term 36 months.
Option B: unit price EUR 5.49; payment 60 days net; contract term 36 months.
Option C: unit price EUR 5.53; payment 90 days net; contract term 36 months.
Binding volume in every option: 30,000 units a year over 36 months.

If you confirm Option A as it stands, we can confirm the order straight away. Since price changes need your pricing committee, please take Option A to the person who decides there. It is one clear step for them: a binding volume, a long contract and steady load for your capacity, with no further rounds needed.

What would you need from us to confirm Option A?

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

Best regards

Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH
